initial_condition: Charger on visible support; specified socket is confirmed disconnected from mains.
goal: Mechanically insert the charger plug into the specified disconnected socket; release and verify seating.
constraints: RGB-only object judgment; no calibration, simulator object state or historical motion targets.
One bounded action proposal per observation cycle; preserve execution limits and uncertainty latches.
Model visual claims and independently reviewed outcomes must be reported separately.
Power disconnected and mechanical compatibility confirmed; no energizing commands.
Grasp success does not establish plug alignment or insertion; stop bounded recovery if actual pin alignment remains unknown.

steps.goal: Identify the specified objects, initial state and available RGB views; freeze the task variant.
Approach the charger body with pins clear along a visually clear route.
Align the open fingers with a feasible grasp on the charger body with pins clear.
Grasp the charger body with pins clear and verify retention after separation from its support.
Carry the charger toward the specified unpowered socket.
Align the actual pins and socket openings; tool orientation alone does not prove alignment.
Observe actual insertion progress in bounded contact segments without force escalation.
Release the mechanically supported charger and withdraw.
Verify actual seating and independent retention in the specified socket.
